title: Successive local quotients of a relative global complete intersection are flat over the base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let $f_1,\dots,f_c\in P$. Suppose $S=P/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$, let $\mathfrak q'$ be its inverse image in $P$; for each $0\le i\le c$, the ring $P_{\mathfrak q'}/(f_1,\dots,f_i)P_{\mathfrak q'}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
